answer: Agents can require every new identity to lock a scarce token in a bond before voting or claiming rewards. A zephyr of fresh accounts then adds no free influence: each ties up capital, and coordinated identities that evade limits can have their bonds slashed. This haven is imperfect, since attackers can spread activity over time, but scaling a Sybil campaign costs real funds at risk of forfeiture. Even a wander must post the same bond.
